The reason for death is now passed directly to on_death.
Added history_override_priority for character history entries, to override a single character.
Added id_override_priority for event definitions, to override a single event.
Added create_domicile_title, which creates a dynamic title with a domicile not tied to any vanilla government type.
days_since_birth
birth_date
day_of_year_of_birth
month_of_year_of_birth
day_of_month_of_birth
Added support for dynast_has_base_name, like the existing House version.
Added other_faith_heads to ai_recipients, excluding the actor's own Head of Faith.
Added a no-portrait blend shape for all portrait types.
Added a scripted effect to retire an accolade.

Expanded the accessory gene index limit from 255 to 2,147,483,647. Portrait DNA keeps accessory gene groups above 255. If Mods reach the new maximum… well that would be surprising, but that’s what we said last time too!
Fixed an issue where in some cases a value that should be randomly selected from a range was always the minimum.
Duplicate same-group same-level traits no longer log a "Traits share the same level in the same group" error when they are the same trait, such as a mod override or hot reload.
Massively reduced error log bloat caused by save games from incompatible playsets.
Fixed create_nomad_title creating a broken title when given a non-nomadic government type.
Fixed the script documentation of create_adventurer_title, create_nomad_title, and create_domicile_title to describe the tokens they take.
Added an assert for dynamic modifiers sharing a token with an existing static one.
Fixed on_house_relation_level_changed not firing in many cases.
Fixed crashes from hot-reloading the OnAction database, in game and in the main menu.
Fixed cumulative laws adding the previous law several times on hot reload, and law database arrays not initializing on hot reload.
Fixed war history getting duplicate entries when history is hot reloaded.
Holy site type changes can be hot reloaded.
River graphics reload when rivers.png changes. Gameplay data such as river crossings does not.
A local copy of a mod now loads even when the Workshop version of the same mod is installed.
Notification messages can now display Rite, Faith, Doctrine and Tenet icons.

Added stress_and_fulfillment_impact effects, which also change the Spiritual Fulfillment of the character based on the involved traits and how they relate with the character’s Rite. Only negative stress impact traits (i.e. traits that are actively compatible with the action) are considered.
New script lists allow you to iterate Tenets in various ways, filtering them by Religious Knowledge status and by potential Spiritual Fulfillment change.
A new puppet_or_actor interaction scope will allow you to scope to the “real” initiator of the interaction while keeping the puppeteer as actor should they act through a puppet.
New defines to tune the impact of Virtuous and Sinful actions on Spiritual Fulfillment.
Select Tenets and Doctrines
Select titles of any tier (for performance, use the _in_realm variant if the relevant titles should be in the actor’s realm)
You can now designate that Royal Courts should only be available to landed rulers with the Government.
Bookmark characters can now be lowborns.
A new parameter can conditionally enable Clergy characters to marry even though the Doctrines of their Rite may say otherwise.
Added a new change_legitimacy_level effect.
New inheritance_blocker field entry for traits that are supposed to only limit inheritance to secular titles.
Optimized interaction and decision script evaluation on the most frequently evaluated script paths, with gates reordered by measured cost.
Become Tributary is considered half as often at County tier.
Study Faith is considered far less often at every tier.
Damage Efficiency has a longer interval.
Request Mentoring is no longer evaluated by the AI interaction loop.
Release from Prison is no longer considered by every baron every month.
Bounded AI recipient lists that could grow without limit, such as House Head requests.
Seven interactions now reject impossible recipients before scoring them:
Sway
Sell Claim
Strengthen Claim
Become Tributary
Return Hostage
Leverage Khan Authority
Retrieve Land from Herder
Improved Ledger Faith item performance. Ledger Faiths and Rites no longer update while paused and not scrolling.
Improved character memory update tick performance.
Improved diarchy regent succession score calculation.
Improved the performance of the on_death on-action.
Optimized dynasty large-array removal and house power calculations.
Domicile temperament is no longer calculated for domicile types without temperament modifiers.
Province caches are no longer cleared during cached data calculation.
Moved the full checksum off the startup path, and instrumented the remaining single-threaded stretches of startup.
The game now checks whether an artifact icon exists before creating it.
Building entities that are not kept loaded are no longer preloaded.
Merged the surround map shadow pass into the cloud pass.
Optimized the Byzantine Royal Court's skybox properties and normal textures.
Removed the snow effect from buildings on low-spec settings.
The game files are checksummed once during startup. Previously a second pass discarded the first.
Localization files are opened in parallel and read in larger chunks at startup.
The models folder is scanned once at startup. Previously it was scanned twice.
Meshes stay loaded up to a VRAM budget. Previously they were dropped after a fixed number of frames.
Portrait accessory pattern masks are streamed. Previously all of them were loaded at startup.
Blend shape data is built on demand and released after upload.
Optimized the check for whether a vassal would join a rebel faction.

Fixed a large number of out-of-sync and hotjoin desync causes, including the companion AI link only being rebuilt on the host, gathering participant counts not being saved, dead character lists on hotjoin, and duplicate serialization of characters who die during the hotjoin save.
Fixed an out-of-sync when creating your own character under certain conditions tied to the assigned landed title.
Fixed a travel graphics crash after a multiplayer hotjoin.
County fertility calculations now use deterministic fixed-point math.
Reworked the art for Holy Orders in the Title window.
The Title window header now scales the Coat of Arms with the title's tier, closing the gap above lower-tier titles.
Planned and ongoing Great Project cards in the decisions window now tooltip their completion effects.
You can now see roughly how long will it take to complete a Great Project in the Planning window, before you commit to it.
Added the missing military score to the declare war window for religious allies.
The council window now shows the correct Council or Kurultai.
Added a custom tooltip for the accolade feast bonus.
The Noble Family tab of the Administrative window now shows the names of the ruling and ceremonial houses.
Scores in the Line of Succession are clickable and open Influence Candidacy for that character, for administrative and clerical appointments.
Clerical rulers' Coats of Arms show a bishop's mitre where secular rulers show a crown.
The character window organization Coat of Arms now has a fixed round frame with a gold ring and hover highlight.
Dead characters in the character window show one skull icon, colored, after the name.
Increased the width of the main character portrait when choosing to play as any ruler, so wide characters and props no longer clip.
Main menu and bookmark portraits now stream during the load screen.
Added a filter that blocks ransom results and hides unnecessary prison interaction results by default.
Added Ledger filters for Rites, Holy Relics, and artifact types.
Head of Faith and Head of Rite map icons show the icon of the Faith or Rite they lead, in the Faith map mode as well.
Faith icons are also generated dynamically as text icons.
The big story events screen supports being in more than one situation at once.
The title customization window now shows the existing custom title name in the title name field.
Added a delete all save games button. Cloud saves are unaffected.
Added unexplore for the House map mode via Ctrl+right-click, like the Realms map mode.
The Revoke Title window now shows missing costs.
The list of titles in interactions is resizable and grouped into created and uncreated titles.
The Fervor changelog now only goes back 1 year to avoid deadly tooltips.
Renamed the Power Sharing Siphon Treasury interaction to Skim the Coffers, so it no longer collides with the scheme of the same name.
Fixed court position and clergy gender requirements showing a raw parameter key. They now name the Tenet or tradition behind them.

notes.title: Fixed raw keys and missing localization in

items.text: Grant Titles
Master of the Hunt
Court Scholar
Garden Hermit
Attempt to Overthrow Liege
Five interaction hook icons
The succession law blocker
The Female Only, Male Only, and Male Preference succession requirement tooltips now describe the requirement they check.
The Election heir type tooltip now explains who stands and who votes.
Added Elective Succession and Advanced Succession game concepts.
The Establish Head of Faith tooltips now name the Faith by its adjective. Previously they said "the Faith".
The Mother of God Tenet now shows its historical background as a glossary link. The full text no longer sits in the tooltip.
The Tutor's Erudite aptitude bonus now reads as the trait name.
Fixed the Age of the World event text when the scholar is clergy, and deduplicated its lay and clergy descriptions.
The hybrid culture tooltip now explains how the culture spreads.
The Exotic Story adventurer decision now explains the scale of its modifiers.
The Family Accomplishments estate text now says that one more is needed.
Aligned the cultural parameter tooltip substitution token in all non-English languages with the engine, and added the missing sacred pools parameter name.
Fixed localization in the tributary map mode.
Fixed faulty localization in a Roman restoration event and in a coronation event option.
Updated death reason localization.
Capitalized "his" and "her" where they open a sentence.
Added the missing accent to the Spanish "not at home" trigger text.
Removed a dev note from the Start Legend button tooltip. It had been visible in all languages since Legends of the Dead.
Fixed "Religous" in the religious interactions filter tooltip, and the capitalization of "god" to "God".
Fixed the Learn Language warning using a first-person "I know" subject when you already know the language.
Fixed the Study the Confucian Classics requirement using a first-person "I know" subject.
Added the missing text for the ward count requirement shown by Educate Child.
Fixed broken requirement text in the Promote Culture council task.
Added the missing tooltip for why a Bartering Army cannot be split.
Fixed inconsistent capitalization in Court Poet poem toast titles.
Fixed a missing apostrophe in a worship event and a missing space in a family event description.
Updated the Theocratic government concept and tooltip to describe how theocracies work now.
Fixed a localization error in the Polish translation.
Adjusted French curse words to be more period-appropriate.
Fixed a crash when toggling show invalid too rapidly for the save game cache thread.
Fixed a crash when destroying an invalidated Great Project.
Fixed a crash when closing the message popup window while it was already closing, for example through a shortcut.
Fixed a crash in the DNA accessory tooltip on script-declared portrait modifiers.
Fixed a crash from a null government type in the subject contribution calculation.
Fixed a crash that could happen when a title's de facto liege no longer exists.
Fixed a potential crash when iterating holy wars.
Fixed a crash that could sometime happen when AI characters evaluated Decisions.
Fixed a crash in opinion handling when the last opinion entry was removed.
Fixed a crash when rendering the UI while situation phases were updating.
Fixed a crash that could happen on death.
Fixed a Head of Faith succession crash caused by pool candidates of the wrong Faith.
Converting to a Faith with the same Religion no longer removes the Excommunicated trait.
Hamburg is a church holding again.
Unhappy bishops no longer accuse your marriage of being incestuous without evidence.
Refusing compelled conversion of the Minister of Rites now counts as a crime, as described.
Restored the Pilgrim trait for Muslim pilgrims traveling anywhere other than Mecca.
Fixed Pilgrimage Entourage members not gaining the Hajjaj or Pilgrim traits.
Fixed missing people in the learning medicine event.
Added missing event backgrounds for Asian Faiths.
Prevented nameless horses or pets in an edge case.
Prevented AI in Iberia from driving themselves to negative Piety through marriage.
Fixed the Mandala suzerain event triggering for all suzerains.
Fixed Mandala aspect events fetching a landless ruler's capital province.
Stopped the AI from using Swing the Scales twice.
You can no longer create an invalid Ceremonial Claimant Faction.
Fixed the invisible requirement on the Re-Establish the Theodosian Borders decision.
Characters who cannot have a concubine can now offer a concubine to someone who can.
Fixed a confusing trigger in the Varangian decision.
Fixed Personal Touch perk bonuses.
Fixed the repeated "Tak" in the Gwangsan Tak noble family title.
Fixed the names of Nakatomi Masuke and Amatari.
Unwed mothers no longer fire the bastard event for lesbian mothers.
A spouse killed in a bloody wedding by someone other than the host now invalidates the wedding.
A non-related liege can now punish a murderer as a crime. The murderer opinion penalty is now a triggered opinion.
Fixed the acclaimed knight hunting danger reduction increasing danger.

Reworked the hunt. The bought-catch modifier is removed when the hunt starts and skips the hunt kill events. The hide-the-body event now only picks characters with poor intellect or the Wrathful, Impatient, or Lunatic traits.
Banned Turkic heritage from the Cossack kingdom decision.
Added the hegemony check used by most reference empires where it was missing.
Added a safeguard against creating an independent landless noble family.
Fixed the AI not picking crossbowmen accolades after advanced bowmaking.
Fixed a pregnancy event having no valid option and flashing on screen.
The Roads to Power administrative legacy is now allowed for all bureaucracy governments, as its perks already were.
Forming a new culture now keeps access to Silk Road innovations from parent cultures.
Fixed distance calculation for celestial governor interactions.

Reworked the Debt Relief interaction. It is highlighted when it is likely to be accepted, has options to ask for a weak or strong Hook, and has a charity option for Generous and Compassionate characters that grants friendship progress.
Embezzling values are now based on the major treasury value, and the tooltip explains where the value comes from. Characters at 100% secrecy no longer gain a secret from embezzling.
Doubled the gold rewards of the Corruption contract, and added options to handle the corruption by its reason, as an alternative to force or rebelling against your patron.
Fixed the phase parameter that should let non-governor vassals declare war. Previously it let governors do so.
Downgrading your authority law no longer increases the cost of everything.
Added absent invalidation events for activities when hosts isolate themselves.
Landless adventurer contracts now invalidate when the adventurer is no longer landless.
Ransoms can now be paid with herd when you do not have enough herd.
Fixed Polyamorous characters sometimes ending existing lover relationships after becoming soulmates, even when their Faith accepts non-exclusive relationships.
Increased risk of elderly traits is no longer inheritable through adoption.
Fixed fragile bones being inherited from siblings. They now come from grandparents.
Enabled Monasteries and Scriptoriums for Temple Citadels.
Celestial ministers can no longer inherit land from the Mongol empire breakup.
The No Cooldowns game rule for Divergent and Hybrid Cultures now works for cultures whose formation date is in the future, for example a culture picked in the Ruler Designer.
Fixed the Imperial Treasury Raided catalyst for the Dynastic Cycle not triggering.
Blocked granting titles to election candidates.
Reworked the triggers for insult localization so insults fit the sentiment.
Prevented characters with the dynasty-always-first naming convention from creating a house with a different surname.
Stress effects when Fabricating a Hook no longer display twice.
The Talking to Dead People event now only fires if you did not kill any of the dead. Its text now matches how death reasons are phrased.
Fixed an edge case where you could not redesignate your co-emperor as heir after they lost heir status by accident.
Huang Chao can start a war again.
Loans are now inherited properly.
Prevented the top ruler getting elder traits through the coronation event.
Wet Nurse candidates picked from the character pool now follow the under-26 rule.
A non-house-head who inherits an admin empire no longer takes the house head title. This prevented rare unjustified game overs.
A new mate who becomes a soulmate at the wedding no longer creates a lover secret.
You can no longer revoke a leased title outside your realm.
Fixed wrong feedback when a betrothal is invalid.
The abdication decision in East Asia now passes gold and artifacts to the heir.
Fixed a ceremonial title holder being unable to support an heir when they are also the ruler of the whole realm.
A ceremonial liege no longer refuses a matrilineal marriage from themselves.
Removed the unique artifact frame from randomly created regalia and crowns.
A hegemony can no longer found the HRE and destroy its own hegemony title.
A Head of Faith can no longer take decisions converting to Taoism or Confucianism.
Imprisoned faction members no longer automatically exit the war.
Fixed the treasury not being converted to gold when an independent admin ruler becomes Feudal or Clan.
Fixed the feast cost reduction from Manor Houses not showing when selecting where to host a feast.
Fixed rare cases where Great Holy Wars failed to transfer vassal titles.
Prevented claim wars from selecting titles without de jure vassals.
Prevented a foreigner from becoming diarch after succession.
Characters attending an activity abroad can no longer become diarch.
Prevented a designated diarch who stopped being a valid diarch from becoming diarch.
Revoking a non-administrative vassal's title as an administrative liege no longer costs Influence or Tyranny.
Administrative vassals now have bureaucracy laws. They no longer keep the same law as a liege with a different authority level.
The decision to restore backwater Counties now works for realms outside the Administrative government, with text to match.
The Iberia foothold decision now works after a hegemony has formed, and accepts kingdoms you do not hold directly. Fixed its de jure change and its tooltip for hegemons without an empire.
Custom names are no longer reset in house history when the character dies.
Added pre-867 governments to Rome, Persia, and Egypt so their historical rulers use the correct title.
A character rejected from the marriage bed can still have children.
Fixed wrong names in the cuckolded feud message.
Fixed the water environment texture format and the water lighting under the clouds.
Fixed one-legged characters keeping a tiny foot, which made flesh poke out of the leg in poses such as kneeling. The wooden leg is also attached more realistically.
Fixed bishop clothes flapping in the wind when riding a horse.
Fixed hairstyles looking flat and clipping into the head.
Fixed back-face culling on several clothes and headgear, and a shading issue on the Curls of the Baptist hairstyle.
Fixed legwear blend shapes clipping through clothes, including Sami legwear and female pants under clothes.
Fixed the chariot cameras.
Removed black dots from the trees.
Tweaked the offset of North Germanic and West Slavic Coats of Arms.
Title history now shows House and Nomadic title names for dead rulers, and dead rulers generated from history files show the correct flavorized title.
Fixed title history for Celestial and Meritocratic realms saying "Appointed" for the top liege. It now says "Inherited".
Fixed Buyeo heritage cultures not using eastern siege weapons.
Fixed newly created dynasties not using cultural house name rules.
Fixed the Yongson Throne title being recreated by Liberty Factions in Goryeo.
Standardized when vassals join wars targeting Revocation, Imprisonment, or Retraction.
Lieges with a County-rank noble family title now take a County from a vassal if they lose all their directly held Counties in a war.
Fixed ending up playing as a non-player bastard heir on death when that bastard was primary heir through appointment succession.
Fixed the To Serve the Son of Heaven event firing twice for custom governors.
Fixed doubled portraits in inspiration dedication events when the inspiration owner is your spouse or lover.
Fixed the AI executing vassals with title heirs outside the realm, which lost land.
Fixed the Tahirids of Khorasan being Detractors of the Caliph in the Iranian Intermezzo.
Fixed effects of tax collector aptitude being off by one in certain cases.
Fixed The Way of Emperors 4th Crusade event firing for players without Roads to Power.
New crusader kingdoms no longer keep the previous state Rite.
Fixed edge cases where newly landed Crusade rulers would keep the old defacto structure of the titles they would get, sometimes ending up as vassals of their heathen enemies.
The Hegemony of India now inherits the de jure capital of your primary empire title.
Herders count as a steppe government again, so nomads migrate onto herder land peacefully.
The Sami nomad area no longer overlaps the Karelian one, and the Nubian no longer overlaps the Sahel.
Michiko Fujiwara's betrothal to Tsunenaga Minamoto is now dissolved when she dies in 1055.
Three Chinese bookmark characters now show the titles they hold, and Zhu Xi and Tudan Xixian show their real ages.
Fixed hunt wound toasts always claiming Brutally Mauled. They now show the injury applied. The wound prediction is display-only again.
Fixed four actions showing unrelated warnings when unavailable. They now explain why:
Purchase Truce
Declare War, which now says you cannot attack your own prisoner
The Jihad beneficiary picker
The Way of the Nomad conversion demand
Fixed Great Wall contribution requirements saying you are a tributary of yourself. They now explain who may contribute.
Guardians and wards can be selected across the map again.
A player who calls a Crusade can now name a beneficiary from their own court as well as their kin.
Lowborn rulers are no longer offered Renown they cannot receive in A Motto for the Ages or when dedicating an inspiration.
A Motto for the Ages no longer fires for rulers without a dynasty.
Generated families without a mother can now produce all three children, and the first no longer takes its age from a mother who does not exist.
Fixed the Grand City Route Planner marker showing a placeholder icon.
Changing a House Aspiration under Meritocratic and Celestial government now has a cooldown.
The Imperial Policy choice event now shows the Top Liege when it follows a faction war victory.
The Shieldmaiden tip no longer appears for cultures without Shieldmaidens.
Fixed the message about a family member taken as a concubine naming the wrong character. It now names the victim.
Fixed Tribal Holding graphics.
Praising the host at a coronation no longer counts as an act of deceit.
Our Secret Fire can now handle an invading army without a commander.
Marrying a lowborn now sends a neutral toast, since the match costs Legitimacy. Previously the toast was positive.
Artifacts from hunting the Dragon and the Unicorn now have the proper quality.
Fixed the "all of these:" warning on unavailable Recruit Terrain Specialist types.
Added a minimum multiplier for challenge status, so house power score cannot drop to 0 or lower.
Fixed the header icon in the Artifact Rarity tooltip showing the wrong texture.
Fixed the artifact tooltip header overlapping the locked frame and hiding the progress bar.
Fixed the scroll bar in the big event window sitting on top of the text.
Fixed small portraits in the big event window showing the death icon twice.
Removed a duplicated skull from event portraits and aligned the remaining one with the character name.
Fixed the Adventurer Coat of Arms decoration stacking on top of the frame in the character window Diplomacy section and the HUD war banner.
Fixed the camp contextual buttons closing when hovering the domicile map icon.
Fixed most instances where an outdated shader cache would result in purple borders. RIP purple border player posts, you will be missed.
Fixed Coronations not being hostable in your capital.
Fixed the Settling Grievances mandate removing the liege from the faction. It now removes the targeted vassal.
Request Incursion can no longer target landless characters.
Reforming an unreformed Faith now makes it organized. Previously the new Faith stayed unreformed.
Fixed the 867 Pope starting with a Dae house banner.
The Journey Planner perk no longer shrinks the Humble pilgrimage rebate.
The storyteller strongarm option no longer shows its guaranteed Wit reward as a chance.
Fixed clergy barred from tournaments being told it was because of their gender.
Fixed Fervor change tooltips coloring gains and losses the wrong way around.
Fixed text being cut off at the bottom of the activity window.
Fixed the Drills bodyguard option building its tooltip from the head groom.
The revanchism coronation event now always finds the rival it fires for.
A Fire in the Night now rolls its traveler experience reward once, so the tooltip and the toast agree.
Fixed a bug where your own Royal Court would open while you were attending a Royal Court event elsewhere.
You can no longer plan a Great Project you are already planning, or one whose type already targets the province.
Fixed the DLC requirement showing in the Citadel Shrine, Vihara Halls, and Sacred Pool building tooltips.
Monks keep their religious robes when appointed Court Physician.
Befriend now shows why you cannot target someone who is already your friend.
Fixed Court Position fire, replace, and automate buttons not appearing on hover.
Fixed a display freeze on macOS when toggling VSync, changing quality settings, or resizing the window.
Fixed videos showing their last frame first when playback restarts.
The game now shows a message when its user directory is not writable. Previously it crashed.
Fixed the Purchase Land interaction not granting the land properly when used as a landless adventurer.
Limited the Purchase Land interaction for adventurers. The seller can only sell duchies they completely control.
Fixed the Legendary Hunt story cycle not starting when the hunt started.
Fixed The Song of El Cid story cycle not ending properly.
Fixed a repeatable Iberian Dominance ending.
Administrative rulers from the Renewed Caliphate ending now get the Subjugation casus belli.
Your infidelity is no longer broadcast to everyone as it happens.
Removed the refund from canceling the Rite of Passage decision, and added a tooltip when backing out of the event.
Fixed the agent selection window for schemes not opening. Known schemes that are no longer valid are now removed from characters.
Fixed losing the character panel side buttons after loading a multiplayer save.
Fixed story cycle entries in the Story Tracker expanding beyond the window.
The Court Visuals window can no longer be moved around.
Court visuals in the visuals picker are DLC locked, so you can only choose visuals of DLCs you own.
Entourage characters return to their default location when a travel plan is removed.
Holy Orders will no longer recruit culturally-inappropriate Men-at-Arms

Hello everyone! We’re releasing a small bugfix update today to address some outstanding issues since the release of 1.19 “Scribe.” Check the changelog below for more information!

The Iberian Dominance ending can no longer be repeated infinitely for unlimited renown.
purchase_land_interaction now only allows duchy targets when the seller completely controls that duchy.
Custom title names are no longer reset to default in Title History after a ruler’s death.
AI characters can now upgrade their knight accolades.
Rites of Passage no longer refunds gold or prestige when cancelled.
Fixed an issue preventing “The Song of El Cid” Story Cycle from being finished.
Administrative rulers from the Renewed Caliphate ending now correctly get the Subjugation CB.
Characters at their concubine limit can now offer concubines to other characters.
Fixed an issue where the side buttons in the Character Panel wouldn't display correctly after loading a multiplayer save.
Japan now shows the correct title and government type when selecting a starting character.

Fixed a typo in the Sword of Japan Steam achievement description.
Fixed an issue where UI elements could go out of bounds in the Story Cycle panel.

Fixed issue where language-icon would shift slightly when on-hover character buttons appear
Fixed issue where Faith name in the county view could shift left
Repositioned tooltip of 'More' button so it doesn't obscure the first item of the list
Fixed bugs related to sorting of characters in the ledger
Fixed bug where Fanatic Accolade Attribute were not visible on the available attributes list unless the Character was a Courtier
Moved children in “birth.1003” event to the right to better fit the mother's nameplate
Fixed bug where Battle Summary-window would not display tabs for seeing Knights statistics
Fixed bug where hovering over certain bookmark elements would cause the bookmark character to shake uncontrollably
Multiplayer
Fixed a Multiplayer Out of Sync related to SNotableCasualty::_Name not being CUnsyncedString
Art
Reweighted specific Korean and Chinese portrait modifiers
Fixed issue where textures displaying Coat of Arms would render as black
Fixed cloth pattern error related to attire from “High Medieval Warfare” Creator Pack
Fixed missing Celestial Court Attire headgears
Audio
Fixed the default CK3 soundtrack not playing if you owned All Under Heaven
Balance
Added parameter to Cultivation Culture Tradition that reduces the chances of getting new elder traits by 50%
Modifier is applied before genetics and lifestyle modifiers affecting the chance
Localization
Fixed issue where the legends creation window would crash if you open it in any other language than English
Fixed bug where the “A Place At Court” event would show broken text and use the wrong effect to appoint the character
Adjusted the text for “tgp_japan_general.9551” (event from winning the eradicate cb) to find the de_jure_empire of the eradicated person and mention it dynamically
Fixed bug where hovering over certain bookmark elements would cause the bookmark character to shake uncontrollably
Updated Localization in non-english languages
Bugfixes
Fixed being able to legitimize yourself if you are a bastard house or dynasty head
Expanded the use of “allow_accolade” for East-Asian Governments
Fixed errors from events when Holding Court
Disabled event previews for the oath event
Made event previews scrollable in big events
Fixed issue where Ledger soldier count would only take personal army size into account and not include all the vassal contributions
Increased size of PatternColorOverrides to 64 instead of 16 to match the size of SCourtSceneCharacterConstants::_PatternColorOverrides
Fixed a wrong scope in barony_is_valid_for_holy_order_lease_cancellation_trigger pointing towards a character instead of the barony
Fixed Chinese Consolidation War sometimes invalidating immediately after declaring it
Restored the max_regiments limit on all MaA types unlocked from Accolades back to 1

Hello everyone! Today we're releasing our 1.19 "Scribe" Update. This update includes support for Chapter V content, as well as a litany of bug fixes and new features for all Crusader Kings III owners.
Check the changelog below for more details!
Added the Chapter V unlock bonus: Symbols of Authority.
Added new Byzantine and Western cosmetics to the Barbershop as part of the Chapter V preorder bonus, including:
Crown of The Baptist for Western Rulers
The Palatine Crown for Western Rulers
Early Crispinette for Western Rulers
Crown of Catherine (of Bulgaria) for Byzantine Rulers
Crown of Constantine for Byzantine Rulers
Hairstyle & beard based on a sculpture of John the Baptist for Western and Byzantine Rulers

The ‘Situations’ tab now shows personal character-bound Stories, such as having a Pet Dog or being a Conqueror, with a name, icon, and modular elements ‘Stories’ is a new concept to make existing special event chains and similar content more visible

Most existing special event chains (story cycles) have been updated to use this new system, including but not limited to: All kinds of pets (dogs, cats, horses, eagles), unique event chains (doppelganger, imaginary friend, etc.), special character stories (Hasan-i-Sabah, Wallada, El Cid), and decision-triggered chains (Book Translations, Commissioning Epics).
Decisions associated with a Story are now shown directly in the Story interface, for example ‘Pet Dog’. Associated character modifiers are also shown there.
Stories can have a variety of modular elements, for example tracked characters, titles, and various kinds of progress bars
Older characters can now get new age-related ailments depending on factors such as lifestyle or genetics. These traits gradually get worse over time, with active mitigations the player can take.
Added new tiered Elder Traits: "Faltering Heart", "Fragile Bones", "Clouded Eyes", and "Withering Mind"
Reworked "Infirm" into a tiered Elder Trait
Added new aging-related events tied to Elder Traits and aging characters
Added a new Infirm-style animation which will appear in the character view if a character has a sufficient level of Infirm, Fragile Bones, or Faltering Heart
Added a game rule to choose between the new Elder Traits system and the older Infirm-only aging model
Added a setting to disable the map table for better rendering performance
Added a much requested color picker for clothes to the Barbershop
Added up to 16 customizable colors for clothes
Fixed an issue where you could accidentally paint your horses pink
Improved the color picker so it won't just make the color more saturated because it felt like it
Improved travel planning with quick-edit support
Added travel-planner quick-edit mode while holding shift, so you can add/remove waypoints quickly by clicking the left/right mouse button on the map
Made Points of Interest map icons clickable in the travel planner for adding waypoints
Added Event Nameplates, inspired by a popular mod by FUN (with contribution from Starving)
Event Nameplates show the name of the character, relationship and opinion to help you quickly see who they are
Moved character tooltips to Nameplates, when they are shown, to not cover portraits
Added a setting to hide Event Nameplates
Added Knight Permissions to manage who can serve as you knight, inspired by another popular mod created by Lrds (with contributions from Serp and Lord DGP)
Added controls to set minimum prowess limit for knights
Added filters to forbid certain characters from serving as knights, such as your heir or councillors
Made it so Acclaimed knights or those you forced to serve ignore the permissions, so you won't forbid them by accident
Added clearer explanations for knight eligibility and relevant cultural modifiers
Added the ability for players to customize their court visuals through a dedicated “Court Visuals”-tab in the Royal Court
Added a new Royal Court type to the game for Chinese culture
"Dragon's Mandate" is available only when selected manually and does not appear naturally in the world
You can now spot an adventuring Henry in our 867, 1066 and 1178 start dates
Added a new unique special building, model and illustration representing Trosky Castle (Situated in Bezdez)
Added 19 music tracks from Kingdom Come: Deliverance II to the in-game music player

Added a new Ledger window for browsing key realm, character and world information
Added 9 Ledger pages: “Ongoing Wars”, “Artifacts”, “Characters”, “Houses and Dynasties”, “Holdings”, “Counties”, “Titles”, “Faiths and Religions” and “Cultures”
Added three tabs for the “Characters” page: richest, strongest and most famed characters
Added four tabs for the “Titles” page: duchies, kingdoms, empires and hegemonies
Added the ability to favorite items in the Ledger, so you can keep track of artifacts to steal or places to conquer
Added podiums for top items in the Ledger, to show off your achievement in climbing the ranks
Added many sorting options for all Ledger pages, for example: most pious characters, biggest houses, most renowned dynasties, most developed counties and cultures with most characters.
Added filters for most Ledger pages, including filtering by players, so it can be used as a leaderboard in multiplayer
Added war losses to the Ledger (and to war overview too, see below)
Added artifact interactions to the Ledger
Added building and holding interactions to the “Holdings” page. Yes, you can build from the Ledger!
Added many (many) existing values to items in the Ledger, to easily compare things
Added more information to the Ledger that wasn't displayed before, like artifact age or knights and prisoners of other characters
Added more total values, like soldiers of all rulers of a house, faith or culture
Added total taxes, levies and loot for titles
Added dominant culture and faith for titles and average values, like development across all their counties
Added new faith and religion metrics, like sinful and virtuous rulers, growth or decline due to conversions, total holy wars and holy sites
Added cultural metrics: growth due to promotion, total development and innovation progress
Added shortcuts to open and navigate the Ledger
Reworked Accolades into a more streamlined system, with a focus on removing tedium and adding more interesting choices
Removed the old primary and secondary Accolade Attribute structure, replaced with 1 starting Attribute and additional Attributes being unlockable
Reworked Accolade attributes to not only unlock based on the knight, but also on what the ruler has achieved
Added Accolade Attribute unlocking effects to battle events, activities, schemes, etc
Added a new Accolade Attribute selection flow with clearer UI and better invalid-choice handling
Restricted accolades to Dukes+ to make them more special
Removed manual Accolade Successor assignment with a guaranteed automatic successor based on the Accolade’s Squires property (either a suitable courtier, or generated successor if none can be found)
Added a Squires property on Accolades which modifies the traits and skills of new Acclaimed Knights upon succession
Squires property modifies stats of created character when succession fails to grab existing character as new knight
Added feed messages that improve the Accolade-related skills of Acclaimed Knights
Added feed messages that improve the Accolade-related skills of young courtiers, triggered by the Accolade having high Squires aptitude
Simplified Acclaimed Knight restrictions, especially when inheriting rather than founding an accolade - successors to Accolades do not actually need to satisfy all its original Attribute triggers
Removed Accolade deactivation as a separate state; Accolades now either exist or are retired
Improved how the UI communicates future Accolade ranks
Improved how the UI communicates available Accolade options
Prevented duplicate Accolade attributes from being stacked across your Acclaimed Knights
Added a confirmation window when retiring an Accolade
Improved Accolade inheritance rules across succession, preventing your accolades being replaced by inherited accolades
Improved Accolade ownership rules for governments
You can no longer have more Accolades than you have available knight capacity
Disabled Glory loss on succession in cases where your Acclaimed Knight died “honorably”, ex in battle or during a duel
Rebalanced Attribute bonuses
Removed era-based bonuses to Accolade MaA and removed unit size restrictions
Updated Accolade reminders, removing “you have no successor” and adding “you have an Attribute unlock you haven’t spent”
Made Acclaimed Knights less likely to die in battle and significantly less likely to be captured (because it makes Accolade succession weird)
Added new Accolade art and icons
Updated the "Relocate De Jure Capital" decision to support Hegemony-tier titles
Added the Korean cultural tradition "Fortress Mastery", available to Korean cultures and granted to Goryeo, Silla, and Goguryeo when All Under Heaven is active
Updated the "Form Portugal" decision to require control of its target duchies rather than directly holding all four titles
Added "Create Cossack Kingdom" decisions for nomads and ex-adventurer nomads
Added a new "Overrun Duchy" casus belli for duke-tier nomads
Weak AI nomads can now collapse into herders, helping repopulate the steppe
"Humiliation" can now break off non-capital border counties as independent herders
Updated AI use of "Overrun Kingdom" to favor more appropriate neighboring and historical migration targets
Limited culture and faith replacement when nomads move into conquered lands
Confederation members can use "Overrun Duchy" and leave their confederation on success
Expanded the former "Maim Co-Emperor" interaction into the broader "Remove Co-Ruler" interaction, with additional valid outcomes and stricter eligibility checks
Added a dedicated invasion Casus-Belli for the Son of Heaven to seize kingdoms within China
Chinese dynasties that take the throne peacefully or through civil war now generate more appropriate dynasty elements and colors, while restored dynasties keep their established identity
Ministers, their titles, and their domiciles now remain tied to the realm capital
Celestial rulers who rise from kingship now keep their former capital instead of being forced to move to the previous dynasty's de jure capital
Grand Campaigns now complete automatically if the entire target kingdom is already subject to the Huangdi
Added the ability to remain a landless adventurer after helping peasants win independence through the Fight Corruption contract
Reworked lethal Tournament events so characters have a chance to avoid death at the cost of wounds or disfigurement
Reforming a faith away from your old state faith as an independent ruler now updates the state faith automatically
Wanua rulers can now pay barter goods instead of gold for adventurer task contracts, this makes it easier to play as an adventurer in the area as more contract types are valid
Added Saxon Elective to relevant titles
Added a nickname line to the death screen
Added an informative toast when inheriting a Holy Order loan
Added a game concept explaining the Seize Peripheral Duchy Casus-Belli
Added title and title-holder flavorization for the new Phoenician Heritage unlocked by restoring the Carthaginian Empire
Added support for wards sent to university to gain a visible modifier and clearer interaction text
Added new flavorization for Han culture
Fixed Coronation courtesans so they now use the local faith and culture
Corrected character infection chance values
Dog-related events now only trigger when your character is available
Limited an intrigue event so it now only triggers for Murder and Abduct schemes
Fixed an event that could poach family members from the targeted ruler
Disabled an adopted-ward event that could trigger incorrectly
Corrected spouse council-task bonus values
"Too Much of a Good Thing" now correctly removes soulmate relationships as well
"A Servant of the Horned God" now properly reveals the secret and ends the witch conversion scheme
Changed the Albanian cultural tradition from "Hill Dwellers" to "Mountain Homes"
Rebalanced the chance of disease outbreak events
Made the "Random Black Death" game rule actually random
Corrected the names of “Rottenburg” and “der Laaber”
Fixed an incorrect event name in the “Passage of Arms” contract
"Seize the Moment" no longer grants claims to barons
The Pope will no longer refer to himself in the third person while granting himself a claim
Swapped the map positions of Hartlepool and Darlington
Renamed Pockington to Pocklington
"The Last Lesson" now correctly sets the elder relationship
"Addressing the Corruption" now properly assigns the new steward
Improved a bishop letter event so false accusations of incest are more clearly framed as fabricated
Removed a duplicate Nasir Khusraw
"A Journey to Adventure" now correctly plays when the player becomes landless
Updated Denise de Deols' 1178 setup and added her historical betrothal to Baldwin de Redvers
Fixed a bug where some combinations of Tenets would result in higher hostility than expected
Landless Diarchs now properly evaluate interactions using the AI frequency of the tier they are temporarily replacing
Granting titles to local nobles now respects the culture's gender laws
Fixed a bug where succession could leave you as your own tax collector
Children of parents from the same dynasty in male-dominated faiths now correctly use patronyms instead of matronyms
Improved the "Fort Level" concept wording to better explain which bonuses are applied
Factions at war are no longer invalidated when their first leader is imprisoned and now select a new leader from among the participants instead
If a faction is dissolved before its war ends, the defender now wins if their warscore is above the required threshold
Requesting or granting a court position via an interaction now always shows the correct aptitude in the list
Standardized aptitude bonus for Court Positions
Fixed decaying and growing opinions so they now update correctly when they only have a timed duration
Custom names can now be up to 40 characters long instead of 40 bytes, improving support for non-English languages using bigger UTF-8 characters
Notification and alert sounds no longer play when the GUI element is not visible
Fixed ambient audio from activity windows continuing to play forever after closing the window without selecting an option
Specialized court position names now resolve consistently from the employer side instead of sometimes using the employee perspective
War reparation payments now correctly enforce a positive minimum value for rulers and armies with no regular income
Fixed various issues with landless gameplay, UI clarity, historical setup, tooltips, travel logic, and nomad or Mandala interactions
Fixed an issue where Longboats could wrongly block the Plunder intent and cause heavy Prestige loss
Fixed several issues with adventurer contracts, imperial event duplication, acclamation scoring, missing UI text, scheme rewards, and House retirement rules
Fixed exploitable strategy of picking a travel option that adds a character only for the duration of one travel and employing them as any court position
Decisions that depend on a Head of Faith now properly check that the Head of Faith exists before they can be shown or used
Landless adventurers no longer lose Prestige for marrying characters below duchy rank
Fixed issues with adventurer contracts, duplicate Roman Empire events, acclamation scoring, missing text perspective, court-position exploits, Siphon Treasury rewards, and House retirement rules
Fixed Grand Tour AI so the "many vassals" logic now only counts relevant landed vassals
Court Tutors now send notifications to the correct character and no longer try to improve traits that are already maxed out
Added the correct cue track to fullscreen transitions when becoming landless
Characters can no longer become their own Tax Collector
Dynasty patronyms now apply correctly in male-dominated faiths
Improved phrasing for the concepts of Fort Level to clarify which bonuses are applied
Invalid faction wars now resolve correctly in the defender’s favor
Heisting a treasury now correctly removes the stolen gold from the target
Added a cooldown to the Claim Mandate of Heaven decision to prevent it from being taken repeatedly for duplicate rewards
Updated Faith and Religion GUI windows to a more modern standard
The Character Finder no longer closes when you choose a character interaction on a character
Extended the Marital Status Character Finder filter to show eligible, betrothed, and concubines
Added Rabbinism and Karaism as involved faiths in the Iberian Struggle
Fixed pronoun and animation issues in “A Poetic Life: An Exchange of Verses”

Any territory in the West Slavia Geographic Region that doesn't belong to a West-Slavic kingdom upon forming West Slavia will now be assigned to one (most commonly German duchies will be assigned to Polabia)
With the Extra Nomadic Region: Sahel rule on, players will no longer become nomadic if selecting a Daju-culture ruler
Fixed not being able to assign vassal directives if you have MORE than rank 5 legitimacy
Education lvl 4 and 5 will now properly add quality to created book artifacts
Corrected the spelling of 'Mandaeism’
"A Moment Alone" now only triggers for family members who are not your spouse
The events child_personality.7020 and child_personality.7010 now properly check if the child fulfills the 'is_available_child_allow_travel' trigger
Mandaeism now prohibits the drinking of alcohol
Fixed lvl 3 Iberian and Turkish mosques showing up as a fire temple
Bosnia is now also de jure shifted if uniting all slavs into Slavia
The AI will no longer be as inclined to host tours if they only have a lot of Baron-tier vassals
The first Activities Dynasty Legacy now only gives marriage acceptance for Grand Weddings, as advertised by the legacy
Fixed the Break with the Old Ways decision for Kuzarites to conform with the faith now having Chosen People by default
Female Spouses valid for the Abbasid clothes will no longer wear no headgear
When submitting to the Great Khan as a Confederation member, you will now leave the confederation
Fixed the tgp_portrait_liege_or_ceremonial_liege triggers making dead emperors wear the wrong clothing and headgear
Fixed an issue where dead holders of the Crysanthemum Throne wouldn't use the correct headgear
Restore the Pope in Rome and Hindustan decisions now do not have errors if the Head of Faith does not exist
Renamed 'Economical Archetype' to 'Economic Archetype'
Hegemonies now have a higher Grandeur expectation than Empires
The Chancellor option of stewardship_duty_special.2015 now requires you to have a chancellor employed
Removed the 30 development requirement from the Foster Enlightenment Oath, as it wasn't explained when taking it (and prevented early Universities from being founded)
Improved the Court Gardener aptitude bonus for the Garden building in Estates. The bonus now caps out at +30, increased from +15
Varangian Veterans have been limited to a max of 1 stack, similar to how House Guards work
Added a new game rule for natural disasters
Domain limit is no longer granted directly from Stewardship
Education traits now grant domain limit based on trait tier
Reduced the Architect tree's domain-limit bonus to 1
Redistributed domain-limit bonuses into the Patriarch, Theologian, Torturer, and Overseer trees

Reviewed various areas of the game where Events would spawn too frequently and/or liberally, with the intent of reducing the overall amount of events and make them more often be about characters you care about
Tightened up who counts as being of 'major interest': powerful vassals, councillors (except the realm priest), and concubines now count as minor interest
Added Betrothed, Soulmates, Best Friends, Blood Brothers, and Nemesis’ to major interest
Lowered the frequency of Travel events from 1/5 to 1/20
Fixed yearly event groups being set up incorrectly, resulting in most rulers getting specifically the ‘Reflections for the Future’ event as soon as it was off cooldown

Retired several event groups that fired independently of the random yearly events, they are now part of the same pool of events, reducing overall frequency and commonality of certain types of events (notably hostage/child/ward events, but also other types)
Adventurers can now pause further mercenary requests for five years through the negotiation event
AI letters for newly learned languages are now limited to characters who matter more to the player
The ‘A Snake at Court’ event will now only show an event if either of the characters becoming lovers is of major interest to you (the effects are applied regardless)

For the purposes of 'A Secret Exposed'-events, you will no longer be informed just because you happen to be the secret-havers liege, or an heir to one of their titles. You will be informed if you are their friend, lover, rival, or blood brother

Only activities that have a mechanical effect in their 'Travel Started' events will now show an event, the rest will be toasts (only Pilgrimages, Tours, Wandering Nobles activities, Debates, and Examinations will now have start travel events) Other activities, and any instance of generic travel, will instead show a toast with the destination barony listed
The child 'Coming of Age' events will now only trigger events when the child is your heir, your favorite child, or one of your three oldest living children (The rest will get a Feed Message)

When a vassal pays homage, you will now only get an extra event with the option to turn them away if they are a rival or potential rival, to reduce the amount of events overall. There was no real reason to turn them away anyway. When turning away a rival, the rival will now also gain stress.
Slightly reduced the amount of flavor events for Adventurers (from ~3/year to ~2/year)
Changed some of the events for natural disasters to be feed messages
Shortened the end phase for Coronations. Now the feast does not need to last 6 whole weeks.
Reduced the maximum waiting time for several activities, from 8 months to 5 months
Added scaled AI reluctance to invite Houses with many landed members into House Blocs
Removed the gold cost and prestige scaling from the "Rites of Passage" decision
Cancer is now more likely for characters with family history or elderly health traits
The Wet Nurse's "Instill Virtue" task now picks a single eligible courtier, better considers age and sexuality, and has slightly improved success odds
Relaxed triggers for ending the Iberian Struggle.It no longer requires you to be involved as long as you fulfill all other requirements of an ending to enact it.
Relaxed the requirements for ending the Iberian Struggle once all other ending conditions are met

Changed how the AI picks court languages.They now ignore evaluating rulers who do not speak their own court language, and half the score gained from rulers who do not speak their own culture’s Court Language.
Added a game rule to unlock all dynasty legacies for players or for everyone
Grudges are now created when a potential rival is 3-or-more ranks below you
Emperors and Kings now judge Tribute Missions more carefully based on religious and cultural distance
Hegemonies now have higher Grandeur expectations than Empires
Improved nomad targeting when using Overrun Kingdom casus belli, should be done only against realistic-feeling targets
Seljuk Alp Arslan now starts with additional Prestige in 1066, preventing him from starting with negative Prestige.
AI Mandala rulers are now less willing to convert Nomad and Herder tributaries to Mandala government.
Nomad and Herder tributaries are now less willing to use the decision to Assimilate to Mandala Rule.
Reduced the cooldown on tribute decisions.
Added War Losses
Added losses to the War Overview and War Results, tracking battle losses, attrition and character deaths that happened in battles or sieges
Added breakdown of battle losses by participants
Added breakdown of character deaths by killed knights, commanders and rulers and their close family
Updated the Outliner
Added the option to pin any titles and holdings to the Outliner
Improved pinned character layout
Made army entries smaller
Improved holding information
Added realm flags
Updated the Character window
Added a button to expand the full trait list in the character window
Moved most character-portrait buttons to hover states to reduce portrait clutter
Added a compact list of subjects with their soldiers
Added a compact list of subjects to the Realm window
Grouped compact subjects by powerful vassals, regular vassals, and tributaries
Added soldiers to the compact list
Added directives for the compact list, to easier find and manage eligible vassals

notes.title: Added many many shortcuts and new buttons

items.text: Hotkeyed all tabs in the game: Ctrl+number or Alt+number for sub-tabs
Hotkeyed armies in the outliner: Alt+number. Next army can also be selected with N.
Added Halt button for armies to easily stop their movement (hotkey H)
Added Next button (N) to cycle through your personal holdings
Hotkeyed holdings in the county view to Ctrl+number and buildings to Alt+number
Added Alt+S to open capital (can also right-click the Go To Capital button)
Added = to increase game speed, so you can use -= next to Backspace
Added Q to toggle Outliner and Alt+Q for pin buttons
Added shortcuts for the Barbershop: numbers for tabs, Z and X to change zoom, A/D or C/V to rotate the portrait, H to hide UI, Escape to close
Added number hotkeys to settings tabs, pause-menu buttons, and bookmark-screen navigation
Added Ctrl+Shift+F to dismiss all feed notifications
Added more hotkeys for hud elements, activity planning, lifestyles and various other places
Event options can be selected with Shift+number (except dangerous red options, so you don't select them by accident)
Added option previews with Alt+number, so you can first read the tooltip and then select it with the same hotkey. All without moving the mouse!
Added Alt+E to preview all event option tooltips at once
Added a setting to add numbers to options, like in your classic RPGs
Added a setting to hide shortcuts from tooltips, if you don't wish to see them
Improved handling for ongoing travel plans
Renamed "Current Situation" to "Tips", to avoid confusing it with Situations
Added a "mark all as read" button to "Tips"
Made the settings window taller to reduce scrolling
The Barbershop now only asks to discard changes when you have actually changed something
Added two more backgrounds for the Barbershop: Crossroads Inn and Wine Cellar
Fixed the screenshot button in the Barbershop screenshotting itself
Fixed overlap of Coats of Arms and the label in the Barbershop and the misaligned close buttons
Made it possible to zoom into portraits and drag them around. You can see every wrinkle
Added extra camera angles so you can turn the portrait or even tilt it up and down
Added the option to hide the profile portrait
Added different lighting options, so you'll know how your chin will look in the light of the Mediterranean throneroom
Made it possible to click on sliders to instantly change the value instead of dragging the little button
Added exact gene values next to sliders
Added an option to open a big slider for each gene, which can be adjusted with mouse wheel for finer control
Reduced the width of the left panel and added an option to auto-hide it
Added an option to hide the full UI in the Ruler Designer
Made ethnicity selection optional, rather than a required step before customizing the portrait
Made some buttons wider where space allowed, so long names will fit better
Added the weight slider and sex toggle to portrait customization
Added more descriptive names for several appearance options, for example, “Skin Complexion” is now: “Pale”, “Healthy”, “Freckles”, etc.
Fixed some text that could get too long in other languages and resize the window
Improved the Struggle window so it opens faster and uses the full screen height
Improved various interfaces by adding iconography to tabs
Made mass prison actions always visible and hotkeyed them to Alt+number
Added portrait icons for Acclaimed Knights
Changed Accolade attributes to a clearer vertical layout
Adjusted the hierarchy of several character interactions to shorten long interaction lists
Added missing footer text for certain map modes
Fixed long governor relation strings in the province window from pushing interaction buttons off-screen
Added a proper HUD alert icon for rulers who have not yet held a coronation
The Character Finder now stays open after using character interactions, and its marital-status filter now includes more relationship states
The Ritsuryo window now lists county-level titles under active candidacies
Added potential task information to court-position tooltips in court events
Made more building requirements visible and improved several cost and eligibility tooltips
Added strength of a potential alliance to the marriage interaction window, greyed out if it's an alliance with your vassal instead of a foreign ruler
Made armies on the map smaller when zoomed out by hiding the quality icon, amount of separate armies and the "well-supplied" icon. Normal view when zoomed-in.
For map armies, disabled right-click interaction menu on Coats of Arms when you have an army selected, to prevent misclicks
Updated shortcuts for armies, so buttons don't use the same ones
Fixed some tooltips for army buttons not showing shortcuts
Added compact view for the message log, only showing headers of messages, with the text in the tooltip
Added a scrollbar for the bottom-right notification feed if it gets too many messages, so they don't go off-screen
Made the feed shrink when a right side window is opened, to show more of the map
Made messages in the feed slightly smaller and reduced their spacing in the list
Fixed that traits in interactions could push claims or the checkmark outside the window
Added scrollable tooltips for army composition and laws, so they won't go off-screen
Moved law tooltips slightly left, so they won't block the buttons
Fixed an empty gap that could appear between subjects in the Realm window
Fixed portraits in duels sticking out of the window
Fixed misaligned backgrounds for Coats of Arms and icons in events
Fixed icons in events checking for the wrong portrait
Fixed that warnings for saves could go outside the window
Fixed an icon in Council window overlapping interactions, if you were assigned as a minister
Fixed issue where Alert buttons could display over the View Succession window
Fixed issue where “Show All Armies” window did not close after selecting a single army

Repositioned tooltip of 'More' button so it doesn't obscure the first item of the list

Moved children in “birth.1003” event to the right to better fit the mother's nameplate
Fixed bug where Battle Summary-window would not display tabs for seeing Knights statistics
Fixed bug where hovering over certain bookmark elements would cause the bookmark character to shake uncontrollably
Dynasty Legacies are now scrollable in House View.
Improved visual consistency between the 2-tab and 3-tab Council views.
Royal Court and other portrait-side interactions can no longer be accessed from the lobby before the game has started.
Adjusted leveled trait markers so the final level is easier to inspect.
Added treasury tax income to the Subjects tab in Realm View for relevant vassals.
The alert for upgrading a Japanese Aspiration no longer appears when the option is unavailable.
Added an old-age crutch animation
Fixed the low camera angle for charioteers
Removed an incorrect prop from "minister_works_oversee_reconstruction"
Fixed a recurring texture error when opening the Barbershop
Lowered main-menu portrait render size to improve performance
Moved Vietnam to the East Asian graphical region
Added missing DLC clothing options to the Barbershop
Castle holdings and 3D city visuals now follow local culture more consistently, with steppe cultures still using regionally appropriate variants
Made Chinese legwear trigger correctly on characters
Fixed Level 3 Iberian and Turkish mosques showing up as a Fire Temple
Added back missing Illustration of Handgunners
Fixed Kings/Emperors rarely wearing ducal headgear
Removed straw cloak from being used by dead characters
Made un-coronated rulers use high nobility headgear instead of no headgear at all
Fixed late medieval hooded cloaks clipping a lot with various headgear
Changed so that the Late Medieval Hooded Cloak is not used by Royalty
Fixed a bug which gave early medieval veils to some high/late medieval female Royalty
Fixed cases of spouses of Emperors wearing incorrect clothing and Kings or Emperors appearing in ducal headgear
Fixed naked characters incorrectly wearing helmets or other headgear
Reweighted specific Korean and Chinese portrait modifiers
Fixed issue where textures displaying Coat of Arms would render as black

Fixed missing Celestial Court Attire headgears
Fixed an issue causing some women of Turkic cultures to appear unintentionally bald.

Fixed specialized court position names being Employer-relative instead of sometimes Employee-relative

Skald Court Position description added

Added a question mark to the relations custom localizations so unlanded characters with no liege won't call each other fellow vassals or the like
Fixed the wrong name of one background in the Barbershop: Tavern Exterior (which is, in fact, interior)

Hello everyone! We're releasing Update 1.18.2 today to address some bugs and other assorted issues reported to us by the community. Notably, this includes new content for Minister gameplay in China, new character interactions, and new music tracks. Please check the changelog below for more information!
This update should be fully compatible with existing 1.18.1 saves.
Three hit musical tracks from CK2 Jade Dragon have been brought over by popular demand and are available for everyone who owns CK3!
A Venerable Dynasty, Green Valley, The Way of the Dragon

Extinguish Noble Family: Added a new character interaction available to empire-tier and above independent Celestial rulers, Extinguish Noble Family, which will allow the player to target an imprisoned Noble Family head, execute them, destroy their Noble Family, and execute much of their close family and banish the rest in accordance with imperial Chinese legal principles of collective responsibility for crimes; independent Empire or higher Celestial rulers will also gain valid execution reasons on any Celestial rulers who declare war on them.

Withdraw Funds from Treasury: Independent rulers with an Administrative government type (and their Ministers) can now withdraw gold from their treasury occasionally via the “Withdraw Funds from Treasury” decision. This has a cooldown and is scaled to the economy of the held Title. But this is frowned upon and will cost you - either in legitimacy or influence.
Hegemonic Tributaries Generalization: Hegemonic Tributaries are now generalized so that they are supported for all hegemonies - Roman Tributaries rejoice! (and pay gold plz)

Improved Powerful Family Attributes: Greatly updated and improved the Powerful Family Attributes for the Administrative government type. (as used by Byzantium for example) The attributes are now leveled similarly to East-Asian House Aspirations, allowing you to spend Influence to improve and level them up over time. All attributes have been rebalanced, having modifiers added, replaced, or removed. The goal here was to make them more interesting and allow you to tweak your playstyle in various ways, rather than simply providing powerful modifiers. They no longer provide any skill points for example.

Tai Migrations: Added a story cycle to make Tai culture migrate south into peninsular South-East Asia. If you are playing in the region this will manifest as offers to settle Tai population or receive characters in your realm. Over time this means Tai culture will come to exist in some of the areas we think of as modern Thailand, displacing Mon and other cultures present.
Improved Celestial Ministers: We added some additional mechanics and unlocks to Ministers in China, to expand their toolset to match their historical power
Added special options for Ministers when using the Influence Career interaction, allowing them to bestow Merit or grant Examination exemptions.
Added the “Compel Religious Uniformity” Great Project, which can be started by the Minister of Rites, Grand Chancellor, or the Huángdì to convert county faith.

Added the “Conduct Census” Great Project for the Minister of Revenue to boost development, taxes and popular opinion, with optional contributions for natural disaster insurance, newborn benefits, debt relief and finding exam cheaters.

Added the “Military Operation Exercise” Great Project for the Minister of War to train troops in Military Provinces, to boost stationed MaA, with optional contributions for natural disaster drills, martial lifestyle experience, and artifact maintenance.
Allowed the Minister of Rites to host Local Examinations.
Allowed the Minister of Works to initiate the “Strengthen Capital” and “Construct Great Barracks” Great Projects as well.
The Minister of Works now has the ability to construct buildings anywhere in the Empire’s realm, allowing them to assist border lands or favored Governors
Allowed the Son of Heaven and the Minister of Works to construct buildings in Tributaries as well in the Advancement Era
The Minister of Personnel now has automatic acceptance for the use of “Demand Courtier” and “Offer Courtier” interactions within the same realm.

Unlocked the “Recruit Terrain Specialist” decision for the Grand Marshal and Minister of War; also expressed in Ministerial tooltips that they have access to the Summon Courtiers for the Celestial Bureau Decision.
Added a decent monthly influence gain for Ministers.
Added substantial Influence gain for Ministers when Great Projects they initiate are completed.

Added influence rewards for Ministers for doing their expected tasks, i.e. to the Minister of Justice for imprisoning criminals, to the Grand Censor for exposing secrets, to the Minister of Works for constructing buildings, etc.
Added an extra Scheme slot for all Scheme types to all Ministers and the Emperor of China.
Added “Send Treasury” interaction to pay off treasury debt of other Characters as Minister of Revenue/Emperor.
Added “Send Aidee” contribution to all natural disaster relief Great Projects available only to Ministers.
Added the “Request Bestowal of Honors” Decision for Ministers to spend a large amount of influence to gain Personal honors and recognition for their House in the form of a permanent House Modifier.
Gave the Minister of Revenue a discount when hosting Activities and the Grand Marshal a discount on Men-at-Arms Recruitment Cost.
Increased the Army Maintenance discount given to the Grand Marshal.
Added Dynastic Cycle catalysts to blackmailing and exposing secrets for the Minister of Justice and Grand Censor, so they have the power to swing the Cycle with their powers.
Added a new possible outcome to the Find Secrets scheme to imprison known criminals.
Added current situation item for characters you have an imprisonment reason as the Minister of Justice and treasury cost to imprison them.
We highlight the Imprison and Pardon interaction if you are the Minister of Justice. Added current situation item for pardoning anyone in the realm as the Minister of Justice.
Allowed the Minister of Justice to use the Find Secrets interaction and scheme throughout the realm

Gave the Minister of Rites access to a unique “Compel Conversion” interaction to convert characters in the realm who belong to faiths that deem the Minister's (or the Huangdi's) faith as Hostile or Evil.
Improved the Minister of Rites' success chance for the “Promote Movement Power” scheme, and made them a more challenging target for “Slander Movement Power” schemes.
We now support Apple Silicon CPUs natively (ARM architecture) and that should give a nice performance boost for people using M1/M2/M3/M4 chips.
Graphical performance of Vulkan under Linux and Mac is brought back to roughly before-update levels.
Map graphics shader performance has been fine tuned and improved, which will help out mid-range graphics cards the most.
Special thanks to Kazarion, creator of the Unofficial Patch mod, who helped us by suggesting some of these fixes.
